question: What is the total share of saturated fatty acids in the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid (the authors' own measurement)?
rendered:
The document states that the fatty acid composition of the macaw palm almond oil is as follows: 

- Lauric Acid (C12:0) ≈ 39.36%
- Myristic Acid (C14:0) ≈ 9.41%
- Palmitic Acid (C16:0) ≈ 7.11%
- Stearic Acid (C18:0) ≈ 2.99%

The total share of saturated fatty acids is the sum of these percentages: 
39.36% + 9.41% + 7.11% + 2.99% = 58.87%

This is the total share of saturated fatty acids in the macaw palm almond oil.
